summary: A weekly board-and-video-game night hosted in-house by River Arts District Brewing Co. (13 Mystery St, Asheville) alongside its own food truck and beer, run by the brewery itself rather than by an independent club. There is no named organizing group, membership language, or dedicated Facebook/Meetup presence tied to it, and the descriptions are identical each week, indicating it's a venue promotion rather than a returning community.

evidence.note: Description is generic and identical across all 18 weekly listings: board games, Rock Band, Smash Bros, food truck, beer; no mention of members, regulars, or sign-up.
No organizer named beyond the venue itself (River Arts District Brewing Co.); no leader, host name, or club identity appears in any of the 18 listings checked.
The brewery's own events page lists Game Night as one of its rotating in-house weekly programs (alongside Monday trivia and Friday free music), i.e. brewery-programmed, not member-organized.
No dedicated Facebook group or Meetup group for this specific game night was found; only unrelated Meetup groups that occasionally use the brewery as a venue for other activities.
